unitText:
[Unit]
Description=Workspace Codex App Server for %i
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
LimitNOFILE=524288
Type=simple
ExecStart=%h/.local/state/previous-workspaces/profile/bin/workspace-host run-codex %i
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=150s

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
